subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Knight Capital Flash Crash
description: One-minute skill: The Knight Capital Flash Crash.

hook.text: Knight Capital lost $440 million in 45 minutes because of a software deployment error. The firm nearly died.

buildup.text: A technician forgot to update code on one of eight servers. The old code sent millions of erroneous orders.

discovery.text: Knight had no kill switch to stop the runaway trading. By the time they acted, losses were catastrophic.

twist.text: The error was a simple deployment mistake — the kind that happens in every tech company every day.

climax.text: One missed server update destroyed a 17-year-old firm in less than an hour. Process matters.

punchline.text: One server. 45 minutes. $440 million gone. No kill switch.

quiz.question: What caused Knight Capital's $440 million loss?
options: A software deployment error on one of eight servers
